name: Cryptographic Reward System & Security-Gated Goals
purpose: Creator roadmap goal tracking, cryptographic hash-chained reward ledger, milestone progression, and anti-tamper task completion verification.
discovery: GoalTracker::get_active_task discovers current uncompleted roadmap milestone.
memory_link: Completed milestones logged as permanent historical achievements in memory.
learning_link: Reward incentives guide curriculum sample prioritization.
self_evolution_link: Successful milestone completion unlocks advanced autonomous upgrade stages.
curriculum_link: Roadmap stages mirror educational developmental ladder.
safety_gates: Cryptographic hash chaining: altering past transactions invalidates entire ledger
Anti-tamper: Tara CANNOT self-award points or self-unlock future tasks
Creator authority signature required to initialize or modify goal hierarchies

lifecycle.1_init: Creator initializes signed roadmap milestones and task tree
lifecycle.2_lock: Future tasks encrypted and locked until prerequisites are met
lifecycle.3_surface: GoalTracker surfaces current single active task to TaraBrain
lifecycle.4_verify: On task completion, TaskVerificationProof audits evidence against goal criteria
lifecycle.5_credit: RewardSystem verifies proof and appends exact-once reward transaction to hash chain
lifecycle.6_unlock: Next task in linear dependency order unlocks automatically
lifecycle.7_milestone: Stage transition validates all tasks in stage before advancing roadmap
